sources.title: XTTS-v2 · Models
sources.snippet: ⓍTTS ⓍTTS is a Voice generation model that lets you clone voices into different languages by using just a quick 6-second audio clip. There is no need for an excessive amount of training data that spans countless hours. This is the same or similar model to what powers Coqui Studio and Coqui API. Features Supports 16 languages.
